name: Lost Deathstalkers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
A couple weeks ago two of our Deathstalkers, Rane and Quinn Yorick, were sent on a reconnaissance mission through northern Silverpine.  We have not heard from them.

They may have become victim to the Scourge, though if that is true then I want it confirmed.  Find these Deathstalkers.

Their first objective was to scout the farms in northern Silverpine.  You should begin your search there.
narrative.objectives: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.
narrative.offerRewardText: You found us! And not a moment too soon...

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 11 to 12, 3,085 XP in all.

quests.name: Lost Deathstalkers
quests.objectiveText: Find the Deathstalkers Quinn and Rane Yorick.

quests.name: Wild Hearts
quests.objectiveText: Gather 3 discolored worg hearts and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Return to Quinn
quests.objectiveText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Wild Eyes
quests.objectiveText: Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

quests.name: Ivar the Foul
quests.objectiveText: Kill Ivar the Foul, and bring Ivar's Head to Rane Yorick at the Ivar Patch.

quests.name: Return to Quinn (Again)
quests.objectiveText: Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.
